title: Mortgage Loan File Disclosure Worksheet: Zero-Tolerance Total of a Revised Loan Estimate
content:
**Worksheet rule.** The standard zero-tolerance total of a revised Loan Estimate on a Mortgage Loan File is the program's fee sheet: the program's underwriting fee, processing fee, application fee, flood certification fee and tax service fee, plus the program's credit report fee per borrower for each borrower on the file, plus the base fee of the report type of the file's live primary appraisal order (the order placed on the file with order reason standard order, transferred in or new order after expiration that is not cancelled; a file carries at most one such order), or nothing for the appraisal where the file has no live primary appraisal order, plus the program's origination charge percentage of the base loan amount rounded to the cent.

**How the total is put together.** Each line is added to or taken from the fee-sheet total once, in dollars, and the total is rounded to the cent.

| Fee-sheet line | Source |
|---|---|
| Underwriting, processing, application, flood certification and tax service fees | the Larkspur program fee schedule, for the program the file is in |
| Credit report fee | the program's per-borrower credit report fee times the number of borrowers on the file |
| Appraisal fee | the base fee of the report type of the file's live primary Appraisal Order; nothing where the file has none |
| Origination charge | the program's origination percentage times the base loan amount, divided by 100, rounded to the cent |

## Standard fee sheets worked through (hypothetical files)

**Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, 2 borrowers, base loan amount 400000.00 USD, live primary appraisal order whose report type has a base fee of 650.00 USD:** 1095.00 plus 495.00 plus 450.00 plus 12.50 plus 85.00, plus 92.40 for each of 2 borrowers (184.80), plus 650.00, plus an origination charge of 0.000 percent (0.00) — a standard zero-tolerance total of 2972.30 USD.

**Same file with no live primary appraisal order (its only order cancelled):** nothing for the appraisal — 2322.30 USD.

**Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, 2 borrowers, base loan amount 1000000.00 USD, report type base fee 1150.00 USD:** 1495.00 plus 795.00 plus 695.00 plus 12.50 plus 85.00, plus 184.80, plus 1150.00, plus 0.500 percent of 1000000.00 (5000.00) — 9417.30 USD.

**Rounding of the origination line (hypothetical):** 1.000 percent of a base loan amount of 312345.67 USD is 3123.4567, which enters the sheet as 3123.46 USD.
